source: harness-effects.md 1.2 (Affonso, arXiv 2604.18596): six neutral label pairs, drawn per trial, option order randomised per round.
draw: one pair per game, uniformly at random from `pairs`, recorded in every move row as `label_map`
option_order: randomised per round; recorded in every move row as `option_order`
canonical: the runner substitutes `label_c` for {LABEL_C} and `label_d` for {LABEL_D}; the logged `action` is always canonical C/D, never the neutral letter
